split_policy.primary_axis: behavior phase before timing workload, generated artifact, or runner bucket
split_policy.positive_rule: compiler throughput rows can cite canonical behavior only through parser, sema, lowering, IR, runtime, or e2e owners
split_policy.provenance_rule: generated docs, command surfaces, perf summaries, cache artifacts, and tmp packages are provenance-only and never define native behavior support
split_policy.retired_surface_rule: old-mode, shim, fallback, compatibility, unsupported, alternate acceptance path, and cache-recovery claims are canonical rejection, strict-error, or provenance-only evidence
